premise: The complete-series reference is the maximum over all concentrations of the same masked DIV-mean effect, so a design whose measured three points already give effect >= 3 is reference-active (equality active). Releasing it as active cannot be wrong. Gate: every calibration and test design of every fitted cell with measured_only >= 3 has truth 0 (active); otherwise the run stops.

definitions.lane_rules: full (AnchorBoost slot, alpha = 1), one_se (the alpha-scaled AnchorBoost of choices.json), measured_only and interpolation: crc_obs of risk_upgrade amendment 004 as written in scale_A amendment 001. A design with measured_only >= 3 is released with call active (0); any other design is released iff its exact margin > lambda; lambda is the first grid value of -1, 0, 0.01, ..., 1 with (sum_g L_g + 1)/(n_cal + 1) <= 1/10 for L_g(lambda) = (1/D_g) * sum over the group designs with measured_only < 3 of 1(margin > lambda) 1(call != truth); exact rational arithmetic; lambda = 1 when no grid value qualifies (lane designs are still released).
definitions.exact_margin: release/paper_nested_decision.apply_rule (integer-count ranks, Margin compared with grid values exactly), the implementation scale_A imports; the saved float margins and calls must agree within 1e-12 and exactly.
